meta.subtitle: Atmanirbhar Bharat · Swadeshi App Directory
meta.note: Swadeshi (Made-in-India) app directory. Play links use the exact package id where I know it, otherwise a Play Store search. Indus links are store searches and the Govt link points to apps.gov.in. Double-check the URLs before shipping. One batch of apps came in from a shared Play-link list, so those only carry search links — the exact package ids weren't recoverable.
